item.title: Write Again … Like father, like son
item.description: We who love to read books, that is, often come across ideas that are thought-inducing. It’s not necessarily something we may like, or agree with, but it makes us pause and ponder. Two such ponderables are in the book “No Traveller Returns” by Louis L’ Amour, and his son Beau. The former was one of the most prolific book writers ever, some 142 in all, in several different genres. item.title: Officials urge Beaufort County residents to prepare for snow, high winds and extreme cold
item.description: Beaufort County officials warn of 8–12 inches of snow, high winds and days of subfreezing cold, urging residents to avoid travel, prepare for outages and check on neighbors.

item.title: Emergency Services Director urges residents to avoid unnecessary travel as heavy snow and high winds arrive today
item.description: Up to a foot of snow, subfreezing temps and high winds are set to bring whiteout conditions and dangerous roads to Beaufort County; officials urge no unnecessary travel after 12 p.m. today.
